## Description
Please include a summary of the change and which issue is fixed. Include relevant motivation and context.

## Type of change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Android/Kotlin Checklist:
- [ ] My code follows the Kotlin style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have added unit tests (`testDebugUnitTest`) that prove my fix is effective or my feature works
- [ ] I have verified the debug APK builds successfully (`assembleDebug`)
- [ ] No new permissions or sensitive data handling were introduced without explicit review
- [ ] I have updated the documentation accordingly
